concept.biography: A pulled-sugar boxer who escaped the confectionery by stretching through its keyhole. Every missed punch comes back eventually.
concept.counterplay: Block the long fist; jump the wrap. Both have exposed recovery.
concept.artStatus: Video-derived signature body motion; generated key poses for other actions. Attached extensions and projectiles are engine-driven.

moves.description: Hit-confirmed launcher; opens an air route at the cost of long recovery.
The limb tip travels outward and retracts; reach is not an instant full-screen hitbox.
Extend, catch, reel in, then launch. Jump the grab or punish its recovery.
Close-range unblockable grab. The victim is held, then thrown; jump to evade.

comboRoutes.name: Pull & Pop
comboRoutes.purpose: Hit-confirm route; end in the character-specific ranged or heavy special.

comboRoutes.name: Pull & Pop / lift
comboRoutes.purpose: Launcher branch. Spacing and airborne height determine the follow-up.

comboRoutes.name: Low opener
comboRoutes.purpose: Alternate grounded permutation with a distinct starter.
